public.title: getElementsByTagNameHierarchy
public.description: input {tree,tags}; tree nodes are {id,tag,children}, tags is a nonempty lowercase tag array. Return IDs whose ancestry suffix matches tags exactly with direct parent-child links, in document preorder. The first tag can occur anywhere and matching paths may overlap. This is a supplied document-tree query, not browser DOM. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
